name: Rainbow
lyricQuotes: I'm a man on the silver mountain
Look into the purple sky / Where the horses ride

shortBio.en: Blackmore / Dio hard rock, 1975–1979. Bridge from Deep Purple to Sabbath’s Dio era.
shortBio.zh: Blackmore / Dio 硬摇滚，1975–1979。从 Deep Purple 到 Sabbath Dio 时期的中间一环。

body.en:
Rainbow formed in 1975 after Ritchie Blackmore left Deep Purple. From Ritchie Blackmore's Rainbow through Long Live Rock 'n' Roll, Blackmore’s neoclassical leads sit with Ronnie James Dio’s mid-range vocals; Cozy Powell drums on key records.

Dio’s work here comes before Black Sabbath’s Heaven and Hell. Later Graham Bonnet and Joe Lynn Turner lineups are separate commercial chapters.
body.zh:
Ritchie Blackmore 1975 年离开 Deep Purple 后组建 Rainbow。从《Ritchie Blackmore's Rainbow》到《Long Live Rock 'n' Roll》：Blackmore 新古典主音与 Ronnie James Dio 的中音区人声并列；关键唱片含 Cozy Powell 鼓。

Dio 在此之后才加入 Black Sabbath 录制《Heaven and Hell》。后期 Graham Bonnet、Joe Lynn Turner 阵容是另一商业阶段。

whyMatters.en: Ritchie Blackmore’s post–Deep Purple band. Rising (1976) and the Dio years set fantasy-lyric hard rock with neoclassical guitar figures.
whyMatters.zh: Ritchie Blackmore 离开 Deep Purple 后的乐队。《Rising》（1976）与 Dio 时期确立奇幻歌词 hard rock 与新古典吉他音型。

note.en: Debut single; Dio mid-range over Blackmore’s pentatonic climb.
note.zh: 首支单曲；Dio 中音区叠 Blackmore 五声阶爬升。

note.en: From Rising; orchestra over hard-rock arrangement, before “epic metal” as a fixed label.
note.zh: 出自《Rising》；管弦乐叠 hard-rock 编曲，早于「史诗金属」作为固定标签。

note.en: Speed intro and stop-start riffs; Powell’s double-kick drive.
note.zh: 速度 intro 与停走 riff；Powell 双踩驱动。

body.en:
Blackmore recruits Elf’s Ronnie James Dio after quitting Deep Purple mid-1975 tour. Debut Ritchie Blackmore's Rainbow (1975) is leaner than Purple Mark II.

Man on the Silver Mountain sets the early sound: Dio’s chest voice, Blackmore’s ascending riff, no Hammond pad.

The self-titled album shows a guitar-led hard-rock band without Gillan or Lord.
body.zh:
Blackmore 1975 年巡演中途离开 Deep Purple 后招募 Elf 的 Ronnie James Dio。首张《Ritchie Blackmore's Rainbow》（1975）比 Purple Mark II 更瘦。

《Man on the Silver Mountain》确立早期声音：Dio 胸声、Blackmore 上行 riff、无 Hammond 垫底。

同名专辑显示无 Gillan、Lord 时的吉他主导 hard rock。

body.en:
Rainbow Rising (1976) uses Blackmore, Dio, Jimmy Bain (bass), Powell (drums), and Carey (keys). Stargazer adds a Munich orchestra—fantasy lyric without prog-suite length.

Tarot Woman and A Light in the Black push tempo; Starstruck stays nearer single length.

Peak Dio era for vocal power and riff clarity before later lineup changes.
body.zh:
《Rainbow Rising》（1976）编制为 Blackmore、Dio、Jimmy Bain（贝斯）、Powell（鼓）、Carey（键盘）。《Stargazer》加慕尼黑管弦——奇幻歌词，但不用 prog 组曲时长。

《Tarot Woman》与《A Light in the Black》推速度；《Starstruck》更接近单曲长度。

Dio 时期人声与 riff 清晰度的峰值，之后阵容开始更替。

title.en: Long Live Rock 'n' Roll and after Dio
title.zh: 《Long Live Rock 'n' Roll》与后 Dio 时期

body.en:
Long Live Rock 'n' Roll (1978) closes the Dio era with Gate of Babylon and the title track. Dio exits in 1979; Glover and Powell anchor the Bonnet then Turner commercial lineups.

Down to Earth (1979) adds Since You Been Gone—AOR polish with Blackmore riffs still central.

Rainbow ends in 1984 when Blackmore rejoins the Deep Purple Mk II reunion.
body.zh:
《Long Live Rock 'n' Roll》（1978）以《Gate of Babylon》与标题曲收束 Dio 时期。Dio 1979 年离队；Glover 与 Powell 支撑 Bonnet 及后来 Turner 商业阵容。

《Down to Earth》（1979）加入《Since You Been Gone》——AOR 抛光，Blackmore riff 仍居中心。

Rainbow 1984 年随 Blackmore 回归 Deep Purple Mk II 重聚而结束。

body.en:
Debut single from 1975. Dio’s mid-range sits over Blackmore’s pentatonic climb.

Early signature of the Dio/Blackmore pairing.
body.zh:
1975 年首支单曲。Dio 中音区叠在 Blackmore 五声阶爬升上。

Dio/Blackmore 组合的早期标志曲。

body.en:
From Rising (1976). Orchestra over hard-rock arrangement and Dio’s mythic lyric.

Often cited before “epic metal” settled as a genre label.
body.zh:
出自《Rising》（1976）。管弦乐叠 hard-rock 编曲与 Dio 神话歌词。

常在「史诗金属」成为固定类型标签之前被引用。

body.en:
Speed intro and stop-start riffs from the late Dio years.

Powell’s double-kick is a clear driver of the arrangement.
body.zh:
Dio 后期的速度 intro 与停走 riff。

Powell 的双踩是编曲中的明确驱动。

interviewQuotes.text: Dio brought mythology. I brought the riffs.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Ritchie Blackmore

interviewQuotes.text: Stargazer was the ceiling of what that lineup could do.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Ronnie James Dio

note.en: Rising / Long Live Rock 'n' Roll; fantasy-lyric hard rock peak.
note.zh: 《Rising》/《Long Live Rock 'n' Roll》；奇幻歌词 hard rock 巅峰。

note.en: Open-chord anthem; early Rainbow signature single.
note.zh: 开放和弦颂歌；Rainbow 早期标志单曲。

note.en: Post–Deep Purple fantasy-lyric hard rock with Dio’s range.
note.zh: 离开 Deep Purple 后的奇幻歌词 hard rock，靠 Dio 音域。
